claims.claim: Lisinopril reduces the risk of hospitalization for heart failure and all-cause mortality in patients with reduced ejection fraction.
Warfarin, dose-adjusted to INR 2–3, reduces stroke risk compared with placebo in atrial fibrillation.
Basal-bolus insulin therapy lowers HbA1c and prevents diabetic ketoacidosis in type 1 diabetes.
Atorvastatin reduces major cardiovascular events in patients with established coronary artery disease.
Metformin lowers HbA1c as first-line therapy in newly diagnosed type 2 diabetes.
Semaglutide 2.4 mg weekly produces clinically significant weight loss in adults with obesity.
Sacubitril/valsartan reduces cardiovascular death versus enalapril in heart failure with reduced ejection fraction.
Dexamethasone reduces 28-day mortality in patients hospitalized with COVID-19 requiring oxygen or ventilation.
Tirzepatide improves glycemic control and body weight more than semaglutide in type 2 diabetes.
Ondansetron prevents chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting.
High-dose vitamin C shortens the duration and severity of the common cold in the general population.
Hydroxychloroquine reduces mortality in hospitalized patients with COVID-19.
Ivermectin reduces mortality and time to recovery in outpatients with COVID-19.
Oseltamivir reduces influenza-related hospitalizations and complications in otherwise healthy adults.
Ginkgo biloba prevents cognitive decline and dementia in older adults.
Echinacea prevents the common cold in healthy adults.
Vitamin D supplementation reduces the incidence of acute respiratory tract infections in deficient individuals.
Omega-3 fatty acid supplementation reduces major cardiovascular events in primary prevention.
Icosapent ethyl (high-dose purified EPA) reduces cardiovascular events in statin-treated patients with elevated triglycerides.
Melatonin reduces sleep-onset latency in adults with primary insomnia.
Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera) reduces perceived stress and serum cortisol in chronically stressed adults.
Curcumin improves symptoms and reduces disease activity in knee osteoarthritis.
Creatine monohydrate supplementation increases lean muscle mass and strength gains during resistance training.
Low-dose colchicine reduces recurrent cardiovascular events in patients with chronic coronary disease.
Low-dose naltrexone reduces pain and improves quality of life in fibromyalgia.
Ketamine (single or repeated IV infusion) produces rapid reduction of symptoms in treatment-resistant depression.
Psilocybin-assisted therapy reduces depressive symptoms in major depressive disorder.
Fecal-derived or oral spore probiotics prevent antibiotic-associated diarrhea in hospitalized adults.
Fisetin, a senolytic flavonoid, reduces senescent-cell burden and improves physical function in older adults.
Sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitors (SGLT2i) reduce heart-failure hospitalization in patients with preserved ejection fraction.
Zinc lozenges shorten the duration of the common cold when started within 24 hours of symptom onset.
